column1: # Wave 23 (W23-10 / audit A-5): the INDEPENDENT ribbon pin.
# loaded capture for the Task tab) BEFORE seeing the gate's pinned list.
# The gate parses THIS file; it no longer carries a second copy of the table.
# The `enabled` column is the port's decision-9 set (which commands are really
# implemented), pinned by name and counted -- not "enabled iff implemented".
# WAVE 26 (G1): every control Project shows on these tabs is now modelled, so
# the kind column covers the real control shapes: `button` (the 64-px large
# button), `small` (one 22-px stack row), `split` (a button with a drop-down),
# Style 16-swatch palette).  `launcher` is the group's dialog launcher.
# Format: tab, contextual(0/1), group, kind, label, enabled(0/1), icon key,
#         stack row (0..2; -1 = not a stack row), state.
# A `group` row opens a group; following control rows are its controls in
# ribbon order.  Labels are the pin's own spelling; the live two-line labels
#   checkbox  checked|unchecked|file   ("file" = the initial state is the loaded
#   combo     the default text         ("-" = no text assertion)
# The font value displays are the FILE's default text style when decoded
# (G3-3.1, W26-REV-4), else Project's new-project default.  Their live state is
# therefore file-driven: the pin marks them `file` and the corpus test asserts
# PROJECT_A's decoded Arial 8 (the new-project fallback stays Calibri 11).
